Name: Shoe color replacement
Author: irowirow
Description:
This mod replaces the color of any shoe with any one of the other shoe colors in the game.

@UPDATE 07/08/17
I recently got back into the game and decided to make some more colors.
Added 5 new colors:
-Blue
-Dark Blue
-Dark Green
-Darkest Green
-Yellow

How to install:

1) Download and extract the file.
2) Chose your shoe color.
3) Put the [b]shoeColors.xnb[/b] file in your [b]Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer[/b] folder and overwrite the original file.
4) Enjoy!
